Name: Multi-Species Fish Pond - Keep up to 10 Fish Species in One Pond
Author: Huykyo99
Description:
# Multi-Species Fish Pond

Unleash the full potential of your fish ponds! In vanilla Stardew Valley, a fish pond can only house a single species of fish. With **Multi-Species Fish Pond**, you can co-culture up to **10 different fish species** in a single pond!

Watch your pond come to life with mixed species swimming together, jumping out of the water, and producing unique rewards!
---
## 🌟 Key Features

* 🐟 **Co-Culture System:** Put up to 10 different species of fish in one pond. Total capacity adapts dynamically based on population gates.
* 🎨 **Dynamic Water Coloring:** The pond's water color dynamically changes based on the primary species in the pond.
* ✨ **Unique Jumping Animations:** All species in the pond will take turns jumping out of the water! (Fully compatible with aesthetic mods like *Happy Fishjump*).
* ⚙️ **Automate Compatible:** Got a chest next to your pond? The mod fully integrates with **Automate** to harvest all rewards from all species instantly.
* 🖥️ **Neat Custom UI:** Clean, custom UI showing each species' count, capacity, and active quest items. No overlaps, perfectly centered!
* 🚀 **High Performance:** Implemented with smart caching (NameCache & FishItemCache) to ensure 60+ FPS and zero lag, even with multiple crowded ponds.
*If you want the fish in your pond to appear sharp and vibrant like in the Visible Fish Mod?
Try my new mod: [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/47433]Visible Pond Fish at Stardew Valley Nexus - Mods and community[/url]

---

## 🛠️ How it works
* Just hold any fish and throw it into the pond. A confirmation dialog will pop up to prevent accidental additions.
* The pond will yield rewards for all species inside based on their respective spawn rates.
* To catch a fish, just use your fishing rod as usual! A random species from the pond will bite.

---

## 📦 Installation & Requirements
1. Install [SMAPI](https://smapi.io) (latest version).
2. Download this mod, unzip it, and place the `MultiSpeciesFishPond` folder into your `Stardew Valley/Mods` directory. or install using Vortex!
3. Run the game using SMAPI!
